text:
morgan (security): Pen test scheduled for next Wed 10:00 UTC. Need to lock down ephemeral access plan + KMS evidence flow. Also want remediation SLAs mapped to vuln severity. Who can own evidence packaging and telemetry verification?
anya (sec-ops): I can own evidence packaging. Will create presigned S3 + canonical manifest. Need list of services & required log exports (CloudTrail/CloudWatch).
devon (infra): For KMS we should use the kms-proxy with temporary roles (sts assume). Limits access to Encrypt/Decrypt for the readroom window. I'll sketch role TTLs.
lina (oncall): +1 on short TTLs. Can we get a 1-hour pre-window smoke to validate that logs are ingested to our SIEM? I don't want surprises during the engagement.
morgan (security): Yes — schedule a smoke at T-1hr. Also asking SRE to enable debug-level audit for the readroom window for affected services. Keep retention for those blobs for 90 days.
sam (platform): I need the exact service account ARNs to rotate and to pin ephemeral grants. Don't give blanket * on service account. List pls.
anya (sec-ops): I'll assemble the list. Plan: presigned S3 + signed manifest + hash. Evidence flow will include: export CloudTrail(ops) -> s3://redwood-pt-evidence/<engagement>/, manifest.json, kc_hash.txt.
devon (infra): Policy snippet for kms-proxy role (example):
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/pt-key"
}
```
morgan (security): Good. Also we need RBAC change plan: minimal perms + audit-only role for assessors. No console root. Can we automate role removal after window?
sam (platform): Yes — we'll use terraform to apply a timeboxed role and then a scheduled destroy job. Need exact TTL and approval owner.
lina (oncall): For telemetry, we'll add a dedicated trace tag for requests from the assessors so we can slice metrics. We'll also increase retention for audit logs to 90d.
anya (sec-ops): Remediation SLA mapping proposal: P0 (RCE/data-exfil) = 48h patch + hotfix; P1 (privilege escalation, auth bypass) = 7 days; P2 (info leak non-sensitive) = 21 days. Thoughts?
morgan (security): Agree with numbers, call out rollback plan + runbook for P0. Add a weekly remediation triage for P1/P2 with owners.
PenTestBot: Pen test intake created: ENG-PT-2025-234, scope attached: staging + prod-readonly-evidence. Evidence window: 2025-08-14T10:00:00Z - 2025-08-14T14:00:00Z.
anya (sec-ops): Action items: (1) I will create presigned path + manifest (owner: anya) by EOD Monday. (2) devon will publish kms-proxy role + TTLs by EOD Monday. (3) sam will list service accounts + terraform plan by Tue morning. (4) lina will schedule T-1hr smoke and confirm SIEM ingestion.
morgan (security): Cool. Also add a retest lane: after fixes mark ticket "ready-for-retest" and we'll schedule a 48-hr retest window. Keep comms here. :thumbsup:
anya (sec-ops): Ack. I'll post links to manifests and the presigned URL here when ready.
devon (infra): I'll attach the role diff and a small runbook for on-call rollback.
sam (platform): Will add terraform PR and tag owners for approvals.
lina (oncall): I'll create the smoke runbook and endpoint checklist.
morgan (security): Thanks everyone. If any blocker, ping me or @oncall.
